methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU-Google AI incubator represents deep capability building in Hampton Roads, but partnership with a major tech company rather than peer-to-peer networks suggests innovation concentrating around institutional anchors rather than distributed grassroots adoption.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Richmond's young workforce facing AI pressure signals shallow platform-driven displacement rather than deep reskilling—workers being automated rather than empowered to automate, pointing toward consumption not creation of AI capabilities.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia demonstrates distributed capability building outside traditional tech hubs, though success depends on whether training develops deep technical fluency or remains surface-level credential programs.

signals.title: Pittsylvania data center project approved with more investment and jobs than previously announced — as long as tax breaks remain in place
signals.signal_reading: Pittsylvania's $100B data center represents infrastructure extraction—jobs and investment contingent on tax breaks with no guarantee of local AI capability development, risking Southside becoming energy provider to NoVA's AI economy without capturing value.

signals.title: U.Va. pilots three new artificial intelligence literacy courses - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: UVA's AI literacy courses signal elite institutional capacity building, but pilot status at flagship university highlights how deep AI education remains concentrated in credentialed environments rather than distributed through accessible community pathways.
